verdict.rationale: Twilio's docs state its APIs can be used through official Twilio SDKs for several programming languages (twilio-docs-25), and they reference a first-party Voice JavaScript SDK (twilio-docs-24). That clearly covers the core of building against official SDKs, though the evidence is brief. Missing for 10: the specific supported languages or SDK reference depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
